what: Retrieve Gridded Weather Data from SILO — silo_grid
title: Retrieve Gridded Weather Data from SILO — silo_grid
text: Downloads weather records SILO Gridded Dataset API (https://www.longpaddock.qld.gov.au/silo/api-documentation/) specified location date range.

title: Retrieve Gridded Weather Data from SILO — silo_grid
code: silo_grid(   lon,   lat,   email,   start = as.Date("1889-01-01"),   finish = Sys.Date(),   format = c("apsim", "standard"),   outfile = NULL )

title: Retrieve Gridded Weather Data from SILO — silo_grid
text: lon Numeric. Longitude location. lat Numeric. Latitude location. email Character. Email address required API access. start Date character. Start date data request ("YYYY-MM-DD" format). finish Date character. End date data request ("YYYY-MM-DD" format). format Character. Data format request API (e.g., "csv", "json"). outfile Character. Path output file data saved.

title: Retrieve Gridded Weather Data from SILO — silo_grid
